problem: I need to build a free customer support system without monthly SaaS subscriptions.
recommendedApproach: Deploy Chatwoot or Papercups connected to self-hosted PostgreSQL, using Cloudflare free edge SSL and Webhooks for email/live chat ticketing.

implementationSteps.title: Provision VPS & Docker Environment
implementationSteps.description: Launch a low-cost VPS (e.g. Hetzner Cloud 4GB RAM) with Ubuntu 24.04 and install Docker Engine.

implementationSteps.title: Configure Chatwoot Docker Compose
implementationSteps.description: Download the official Chatwoot production compose manifest and configure your domain and SMTP credentials.

implementationSteps.title: Embed Live Chat Widget into Web Application
implementationSteps.description: Add the lightweight async widget script into your website HTML.
implementationSteps.codeSnippet:
<script>
  (function(d,t) {
    var BASE_URL="https://support.yourdomain.com";
    var g=d.createElement(t),s=d.getElementsByTagName(t)[0];
    g.src=BASE_URL+"/packs/js/sdk.js";
    g.defer = true;
    g.async = true;
    s.parentNode.insertBefore(g,s);
  })(document,"script");
</script>

verificationSteps: Send a test message through the live chat widget and confirm arrival in Chatwoot dashboard.
Verify inbound SMTP routing or SendGrid free tier webhook delivery.
Inspect TLS certificate validity over HTTPS.

commonErrors.resolution: Ensure the Redis container is attached to the same Docker bridge network as the Rails application.

commonErrors.error: Emails failing with 550 Relay Access Denied
commonErrors.resolution: Verify DNS SPF and DKIM records for your sending domain.

problem: I need to build an offline document search and retrieval system without sending data to OpenAI or paid vector clouds.
recommendedApproach: Use Ollama for local embeddings (nomic-embed-text) and generation (mistral / llama3) paired with an embedded Chroma vector store.

implementationSteps.title: Install and Run Ollama Models
implementationSteps.description: Download local embedding and inference models directly to your machine.
implementationSteps.codeSnippet:
ollama pull nomic-embed-text
ollama pull llama3:8b

implementationSteps.title: Index Documents in Local Chroma
implementationSteps.description: Chunk markdown and code files, extract embeddings, and persist to local SQLite vector store.
implementationSteps.codeSnippet:
import chromadb
from chromadb.utils import embedding_functions

client = chromadb.PersistentClient(path='./chroma_db')
collection = client.get_or_create_collection('docs')
collection.add(documents=['Sample document text'], ids=['doc_1'])

verificationSteps: Perform vector query with local query text.
Check that zero outbound HTTP calls occur outside localhost.
Verify query response latency on CPU vs GPU.

commonErrors.error: Out of memory during model inference
commonErrors.resolution: Switch from a 70B model to an 8B quantized Q4_K_M model or increase swap space.
